description: Automated maintenance for Iceberg tables: data compaction, delete-file rewrite, snapshot expiration, orphan removal, and manifest rewriting

admin_config_form.title: Iceberg Maintenance Admin Config
admin_config_form.description: Admin-side controls for Iceberg table maintenance scope.

sections.title: Scope
sections.description: Filters to restrict which tables are scanned for maintenance.

fields.name: bucket_filter
fields.label: Bucket Filter
fields.description: Comma-separated wildcard patterns for table buckets (* and ? supported). Blank = all.

fields.name: namespace_filter
fields.label: Namespace Filter
fields.description: Comma-separated wildcard patterns for namespaces (* and ? supported). Blank = all.

fields.name: table_filter
fields.label: Table Filter
fields.description: Comma-separated wildcard patterns for table names (* and ? supported). Blank = all.

sections.title: Resource Groups
sections.description: Controls for fair proposal distribution across buckets or namespaces.

fields.name: resource_group_by
fields.label: Group Proposals By
fields.description: When set, detection emits proposals in round-robin order across the selected resource group.

fields.name: max_tables_per_resource_group
fields.label: Max Tables Per Group
fields.description: Optional cap on how many proposals a single resource group can receive in one detection run. Zero disables the cap.

fields.name: snapshot_retention_hours
fields.label: Retention (hours)
fields.description: Expire snapshots older than this many hours.

fields.name: max_snapshots_to_keep
fields.label: Max Snapshots
fields.description: Always keep at least this many most recent snapshots.

sections.title: Data Compaction
sections.description: Controls for bin-packing or sorting small Parquet data files.

fields.name: target_file_size_mb
fields.label: Target File Size (MB)
fields.description: Files smaller than this (in megabytes) are candidates for compaction.

fields.name: min_input_files
fields.label: Min Input Files
fields.description: Minimum number of small files in a partition to trigger compaction.

fields.name: apply_deletes
fields.label: Apply Deletes
fields.description: When true, compaction applies position and equality deletes to data files. When false, tables with delete manifests are skipped.

fields.name: rewrite_strategy
fields.label: Rewrite Strategy
fields.description: binpack keeps the existing row order; sort rewrites each compaction bin using the Iceberg table sort order; auto sorts tables that declare one and bin-packs the rest.

fields.name: sort_buffer_rows
fields.label: Sort Buffer Rows
fields.description: Rows a sorted rewrite holds in memory before spilling a sorted run to disk. The writer merges at most 32K runs, so this also bounds how many rows one output file can hold.

fields.name: sort_spill_dir
fields.label: Sort Spill Directory
fields.description: Directory holding a sorted rewrite's temporary runs. Empty uses the system temp directory.

fields.name: sort_max_input_mb
fields.label: Sort Max Input (MB)
fields.description: Optional hard cap for the total bytes in a sorted compaction bin. Zero = no extra cap beyond binning.

sections.title: Delete Rewrite
sections.description: Controls for rewriting small position-delete files into fewer larger files.

fields.name: delete_target_file_size_mb
fields.label: Delete Target File Size (MB)
fields.description: Target size for rewritten position-delete files.

fields.name: delete_min_input_files
fields.label: Delete Min Input Files
fields.description: Minimum number of position-delete files in a group before rewrite is triggered.

fields.name: delete_max_file_group_size_mb
fields.label: Delete Max Group Size (MB)
fields.description: Skip rewriting delete groups larger than this bound.

fields.name: delete_max_output_files
fields.label: Delete Max Output Files
fields.description: Maximum number of rewritten delete files a single group may produce.

fields.name: orphan_older_than_hours
fields.label: Safety Window (hours)
fields.description: Only remove orphan files older than this many hours.

fields.name: min_manifests_to_rewrite
fields.label: Min Manifests
fields.description: Minimum number of manifests before rewriting is triggered.

fields.name: max_commit_retries
fields.label: Max Commit Retries
fields.description: Maximum number of commit retries on version conflict.

fields.name: operations
fields.label: Operations
fields.description: Comma-separated list of operations to run: compact, rewrite_position_delete_files, expire_snapshots, remove_orphans, rewrite_manifests, or 'all'.

fields.name: table_properties_override
fields.label: Table Properties Win
fields.description: Let a table's own Iceberg properties override these settings and its maintenance configuration. Clear to make the maintenance configuration authoritative.

fields.name: where
fields.label: Where Filter
fields.description: Optional partition filter for compact, rewrite_position_delete_files, and rewrite_manifests. Supports field = literal, field IN (...), and AND.
